display.purpose: Page headings, section titles, and considered empty-state titles.

body.purpose: Controls, lists, labels, metadata, settings, and dense task UI.

mono.purpose: Logs, counters, ids, timestamps, and tabular diagnostics.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary amber action for the next clear step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:hsl(28 90% 58%); color:hsl(28 10% 6%); font:600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.30), 0 0 0 1px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.50) inset; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:hsl(28 90% 53%); box-shadow:0 2px 8px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px hsl(28 10% 7%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.45); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact field for settings, filters, and search-like forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width:260px; height:36px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid hsl(28 7% 16%); border-radius:6px; background:hsl(28 8% 9%); color:hsl(28 10% 95%); font:500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:hsl(28 6% 62% / 0.70); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:hsl(28 7% 22%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:hsl(28 90% 58%); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.25); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:2px 8px; border:1px solid hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.20); border-radius:6px; background:hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.10); color:hsl(28 90% 58%); font:500 12px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: App Surface
components.description: Flat task container for settings, tables, or metadata.
components.html:
运行状态

所有站点运行时正常。
components.css: .ds-surface { width:300px; padding:16px; border:1px solid hsl(28 7% 16% / 0.65); border-radius:8px; background:hsl(28 8% 9%); color:hsl(28 10% 95%); box-shadow:0 1px 2px hsl(28 10% 95% / 0.04); } .ds-surface h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font:600 17px/1.3 Newsreader, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-surface p { margin:0; color:hsl(28 6% 62%); font:400 14px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.css: .ds-sidebar-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; height:36px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:6px; color:hsl(28 6% 62%); text-decoration:none; font:500 13px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-sidebar-item:hover { background:hsl(28 8% 15%); color:hsl(28 10% 95%); } .ds-sidebar-item-active { background:hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.10); color:hsl(28 10% 95%); } .ds-sidebar-dot { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:999px; background:hsl(28 90% 58%); } .ds-sidebar-item:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px hsl(28 10% 5%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(28 90% 58% / 0.40); }

components.name: Skeleton Block
components.description: Shared placeholder block for loading lists and media grids.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { position:relative; overflow:hidden; width:220px; height:124px; border-radius:6px; background:hsl(28 7% 11% / 0.60); } .ds-skeleton::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; transform:translateX(-100%); background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, hsl(28 10% 95% / 0.05), transparent); animation:ds-shimmer 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-shimmer { 100% { transform:translateX(100%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skeleton::after { animation:none; } }

narrative.overview: A desktop-first media archive interface with quiet chrome, amber state, dense controls, and media-led content. Existing screens are diagnostic evidence, not the visual authority; redesign flawed hierarchy, spacing, and effects instead of preserving them.
keyCharacteristics: Current UI treated as baseline evidence, not target quality

rules.name: The Amber Is State Rule
rules.body: Use amber for selection, focus, primary action, brand identity, and concrete status.

rules.name: The Flat Until It Moves Rule
rules.body: Keep cards and panels nearly flat at rest; use elevation to explain overlays and state.

rules.name: The Current UI Is Not Sacred Rule
rules.body: Use existing code to understand product flow and constraints, then redesign flawed visual hierarchy, spacing, effects, and component behavior from the root.

dos: Do reuse existing CSS variables only when they support the target design.
Do change or remove current visual treatments when they encode the design problem.
Do show concrete runtime and media state.
donts: Don't add mobile-first breakpoints unless explicitly requested.
Don't use decorative gradient text, glassmorphism, or generic dashboard hero metrics.
Don't hide broken server, runtime, auth, or media states behind generic fallback copy.
Don't treat existing pages as approved visual references.
